biography.plain_text: Luka Jakir is a Croatian captain and maritime entrepreneur from Makarska. Raised in a seafaring family, he learned seamanship alongside his brother Filip and followed their father and grandfather into professional command. He now helps lead the family’s charter operation, combining onboard experience with the development and management of a new generation of Croatian-built craft.

long_biography.plain_text:
Life at sea shaped Luka Jakir long before he became a captain. He and his brother Filip grew up aboard their father Josip’s wooden ship, learning from a family whose maritime tradition extends through several generations. Luka later spent years working in the charter sector and studied at the Faculty of Maritime Studies.

Within the Makarska family business, he combines command experience with recruiting, guest operations and fleet development. Luka and Filip describe their work as a continuation of the practical seamanship taught by their father and grandfather. The business recruits and manages local crews while drawing on Croatian maritime expertise.
